content:
For the perk found in Nuclear Winter, see Nuclear Winter perks.

“It's all about focus.”

**Sniper** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Gain improved control and hold your breath longer while aiming scopes.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain improved control and hold your breath 75% longer while aiming scopes. | 0004C92A | 

- The pupil that is meant to be in the scope of the rifle is floating off the side of the weapon.
- Before update 60, the perk had 3 ranks that provided improved control and increased breath holding by 25%/50%/75% while aiming scopes.
